HEPA filters for the eufy X9 Pro vacuum cleaner. Please confirm your machine model before purchasing.
The HEPA filter traps fine dust and odours and filters 99% of the dust in the air. Replacing it every three months is recommended.
Made from high-quality non-woven fabric using advanced technology for higher filtration efficiency at lower pressure.
The filter can be washed. After a period of use, rinse it with clean water and let it dry completely before refitting.
Simply open the machine and fit the new filter. It is fully compatible with the eufy Clean X9 Pro and helps extend the life of the machine.
